summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line file shipped in the package root tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs` with hex-obfuscated identifiers and a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW`). math_init.js is not referenced from the package's normal `dist/` graph and its filename does not match the package's declared notifications-UI purpose. The alternate runtime is used to run a payload whose behavior is not statically inspectable, executing at install time on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
